notes.title: 【泞之翼3：望日篇】测试开始
notes.content:
Greetings, players!

After a long period of development, our game [i]Ning's Wing 3: The Hexad Trials[/i] is moving into an exciting new phase. During the International Workers’ Day holiday, T34 Studio will be releasing a standalone episode from our latest chapter for public testing. This episode has already been tested internally by our trusted friends.

[i]Ning's Wing 3：The Sunflower in Winter[/i] is set against the backdrop of World War II. The heroine, Isabella Brilo, finds herself trapped in a school that has been converted into a prison. Will she be able to escape this nightmare with her friends?

As the main game has not yet been released, this standalone episode will not be available as a DLC. To play this version, you must first join the Steam Playtest for [i]Ning's Wing 3: The Hexad Trials[/i]. 

To switch to this special edition in the Steam client, right-click on the game from the library page and select "Properties". Among the available tabs will be the "Betas" tab.

Please type in [b][u]HelianthusAnnuus[/u][/b] as the beta access code in the private beta input, and press the button next to the input. You should be able to switch to "sunflower - 望日篇" in the beta participation select now.

During the test, if you want to switch back to the standard version, you could click on the beta select and set back to "None".

Please be advised that this limited release will be closed at 23:59 on May 4th, 2025 Beijing Time (UTC+8). After the release is closed, you will not be able to play this game via Steam.

各位玩家好，经过长时间的开发和制作，《泞之翼3：梦想》的开发进度已经进入到一个新的阶段。正值五一期间，T34工作室将会发布一份《泞之翼3：梦想》的独立篇章。该篇章是我们开发中游戏的一个较为独立的章节，经过内测玩家进行测试后，决定于五一小长假期间限时以测试形式发布，切勿错过。

《泞之翼3：望日篇》（又名向日葵的冬天）是一款基于二战背景创作的密室逃脱解谜游戏。游戏主人公伊莎贝拉·布莉萝受困于一座由学校改建的临时监狱之中，为了与同伴逃离这个地方，经历了一场惊心动魄的冒险。

由于游戏本体尚未发布，这份版本将暂时不以DLC的形式推出，参与测试需要先参与本体测试 Playtest。

请在您的 Steam 库里找到 泞之翼3：梦想 的 Playtest 版本，右键点击“属性”，并在弹窗中切换到“测试版”选项。在“私密测试”一栏中，填写密码 [b][u]HelianthusAnnuus[/u][/b] 并选择右侧按钮，即可在上方的“参与测试”选项中选择“sunflower - 望日篇”版本。

测试期间，如果您想切换回标准版本，您可以在“参与测试”中切换回“无”。

请注意，本测试将于北京时间2025年5月4日晚上23:59关闭。关闭后，您无法通过 Steam 游玩该版本。
